a: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
p: Wa qul rabbi anzilnī munzalan mubārakan wa anta khayru-l-munzilīn.
m: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
